name: egfr_calc
description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate by the race-free CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation, and optionally the 2021 creatinine-cystatin C equation, with creatinine in mg/dL or umol/L, reported in whole numbers as the NKF recommends and staged G1 to G5 (KDIGO 2012). Adults only. Every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice, verify with a clinician.

cystatin_c.description: Serum cystatin C in mg/L; adds eGFRcr-cys

catalog.source: Inker LA et al., New creatinine- and cystatin C-based equations to estimate GFR without race, N Engl J Med 2021;385:1737-49; National Kidney Foundation implementation guidance and test values; KDIGO 2012 CKD guideline (G categories)
